review_scope: All 88 current primary selected frames only: video1=8, video2=12, video4=53, video5=15. Nearby frames and missed GT leaves were not reviewed here.
method: Direct visual inspection of contact sheets of original selected frames, followed by 31 original-resolution detail crops. Local PIL crop/rotation only; no OCR re-run, paid model call or upload. Existing native OCR orientation metadata provided display hints, which were manually overridden when visibly wrong. No model classification or extracted-field result was used to decide usability.

criteria.required_fields: Own document heading/form identity plus all required number/date/organization/address fields visually readable in this exact displayed frame; same-frame он же reference may be resolved to readable seller. A continuation lacking front fields is not usable for complete field extraction.
criteria.non_target: Own form heading/identity readable and expanded body visible, sufficient for rejection. Required target-field readability is not claimed.
criteria.uncertain: A displayed continuation has readable notes but no own main heading, preventing definite rejection under this rule. Null usable is uncertainty, not success.

provenance.source_sha256: Copied from corresponding current runs/mvp trace.jsonl run_started.source_id (pipeline hash); source video hash not recomputed during this visual review.
provenance.frame_sha256: Independently computed from original primary PNG bytes before review; all rechecked at report creation.
provenance.candidate_intervals: Copied unchanged from current selected-pages.json; not GT intervals.
provenance.assets: Persistent contact sheets and crops are saved alongside this report under selected-frame-usability-evidence. Crop transforms map continuous pixel edges and retain original dimensions.

limitations: Provisional independent visual judgment by an assistant, not customer-signed acceptance or a second human annotator.
This report assesses exact current selected frames, not segment recall or all ground-truth leaf intervals; do not treat 73/88 as a contractual success rate.

No existing GT type, field, document boundary or time interval was changed. Mapping to GT intervals remains separate. In particular, video5 page5 frame41 timestamp21.324s remains unchanged even if it lies outside the prior front-leaf GT interval.
Non-target usable judgments concern form rejection only; small names, dates, product values and legal completeness were not exhaustively checked.
Missing front fields on continuations are a field-availability limitation, not a claim that the visible table is blurred or unreadable.
Some native OCR hints invert unknown portrait declarations/acts; manual display rotation is recorded without modifying source frames or cached OCR.
